name: Ayase Kizuki
source:
Ayumu's childhood friend.
She has been helping Ayumu, who has been bullied for a long time and comes to wake him up every morning. She is a bright, energetic and cheerful girl. When Yuri's magic causes Ayumu to have trouble leaving the house, she has no choice but to help him with his sexual desires.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=417865]Getchu[/url] and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/感汁・魔汁・ぶっかけ性活]Wikipedia[/url]]
